issue.title: bugyi-chops GitHub repo description still advertises the retired recent-commit audits
issue.description:
`gh repo view bbugyi200/bugyi-chops` (and therefore `sase plugin list`/`sase plugin show bugyi-chops`, which render the GitHub description) still say: "Proposal-emitting SASE axe chops for recent-commit audits and oversized-file splitting".

Both halves are now wrong. Epic sase-jz deleted the recent-commit audit chops (bugyi-chops 0.5.0, commit c83557a) and replaced ci_watch's Axe proposals with durable LaunchApproval gates (e1dadf0), so the package supplies two console scripts (`bugyi_chop_ci_watch`, `bugyi_chop_toobig_split`) and ci_watch emits no `proposed_launches` at all.

Repro: `sase plugin show bugyi-chops --refresh` renders the stale sentence.

Fix: pick new wording and apply it with `gh repo edit bbugyi200/bugyi-chops --description "<new text>"`. No code change. Proposed by the sase-jz land agent; the sase-jz plan deliberately put this out of scope because the description text is the project owner's call, not an agent's.

payload.entry: RELATED: sase-jz — this epic removed the audit chops and the proposal path the description advertises; the description edit was explicitly out of that plan's scope as a user decision.
